svg.aria-label: Four wheels of chances for the letter after good m. Boldness 0.5: y 61.1%, e 26.6%, a 8.5%. Boldness 1, the wheel as it is: y 40.8%, e 26.9%, a 15.2%. Boldness 2: y 25.9%, e 21.0%, a 15.8%, with much more of the wheel in thin grey slices. Top-p 90%: only five slices kept, y, e, a, o and i, stretched to fill the wheel.
svg.text: The same chances, adjusted just before the spin. Real numbers from my trained model.
Grey slices are letters under 2.5% each. Turning boldness up hands more of the wheel to them; top-p cuts them off.
